# HaulOS maps

Map data used by the GPS in [HaulOS](https://github.com/damionthomasson/haulos-releases), the companion app for Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator.

HaulOS downloads the map for your game once, keeps it on your PC and uses it offline. You don't need to download anything from here yourself.

## Credit

**Map data: [TruckSim Maps](https://github.com/truckermudgeon/maps) by Trucker Mudgeon.** These files are copies of the `ats.pmtiles` and `ets2.pmtiles` map tiles generated by TruckSim Maps. They are hosted here so HaulOS doesn't use the TruckSim Maps servers. TruckSim Maps' source code is licensed under GPL-3.0. Its maps are built from the game files of *Euro Truck Simulator 2* and *American Truck Simulator* by SCS Software.

HaulOS is a fan-made project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by SCS Software or TruckSim Maps.

## Files

Each release contains:

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `ats.pmtiles` | American Truck Simulator map (vector tiles, PMTiles v3) |
| `ets2.pmtiles` | Euro Truck Simulator 2 map (vector tiles, PMTiles v3) |
| `maps.json` | Index HaulOS reads: version, sizes and SHA-256 checksums |
